newsitem.title: UK: Brent moves lower at April Brent -8 cents - trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent moves lower at April Brent -8 cents - trade.

text.p: A cargo of Brent Blend crude oil traded on Wednesday at April Brent minus eight cents, sharply down from a deal on Tuesday at April +12 cents, traders said.
The cargo, originally offered at April +5 cents, was one of two March 19-21 loaders shown to the market on Wednesday.

"It's quite a way down (from the previous trade) but the following week's dates are starting to be offered in the April minus the teens range, so this was not too bad a price," a trader said. Traders added that the support derived by prompt cargoes from Glencore's buying last week and from loading delays was starting to wear off.
The Dated Brent cargo traded on Tuesday was a March 15-17 loader.
One Brent cargo, loading March 20-22 was passing through the paper chains on Wednesday.
CFDs and intermonth spreads were mixed. This week's CFDs were unchanged at April 0.00/0.04 cents. The following week softened to around April -10 cents, about four cents weaker from midday.
Intermonth spreads were mixed. March/April paper was talked down at +12/+20 cents from +21/+25 at midday. April/May was two cents firmer at +37/38 cents.
